prompt:
Use case: identity-preserving pose sheet for a desktop pet. The reference is the ONLY source of adult face, rendering style, body proportions, hair, accessories, clothing and footwear. Keep the original polished 3D animation rendering style and adult proportions.
Draw a portrait-oriented 1024x1536 transparent sprite sheet containing 9 COMPLETE SMALL full-body figures, organized into 3 rows and 3 columns. Preserve her exact original outfit and original adult body proportions in every pose. Long legs, small adult head, NOT CHIBI. All nine figures the same head-to-foot size. Each figure only 65% of its invisible cell height with generous transparent margins; no cropping of hair, hat, dress or shoes, especially the bottom row. Fixed front view.
Top row sequence: 1 right fingers hold a small bread roll at chest; 2 right hand brings bread to lips and takes a bite; 3 right hand lowers bitten bread, chewing.
Middle row sequence: 4 left palm supports a light-blue rice bowl, right fingers hold a spoon over it; 5 right hand raises spoon to mouth while left hand continues holding bowl; 6 spoon returns to bowl.
Bottom row: 7 both open hands reach forward to receive a small ball; 8 elbows flex gently as both hands recoil; 9 both palms cup an EMPTY grapefruit-sized sphere at chest height. Keep a clear round gap between the two palms, NO ball drawn, NO prayer hands. Wrists higher than elbows. Anatomically plausible shoulder-elbow-wrist-fingers in all poses.
NO background, backlight, glow, colored halo or scattered pixels. Ignore all glow from the reference. Crisp clean true-alpha silhouettes with no outside debris. No text, labels, panels or shadows.
Every row MUST show the complete original lower legs and shoes. Keep the original long adult legs and small adult head identical across all nine poses. Do not shorten legs in the bottom row. All nine figures are uniformly scaled complete head-to-toe views, planted feet, at least 10px transparent padding. Portrait-oriented canvas gives enough height for all 9 full adult bodies.
